description: This file contains implementation of back-end APIs for managing DHCPv6 configuration in a network device, including creation, initialization, removal, and registry synchronization of DHCPv6 client data, server options, sent options, and received options. It interfaces with a configuration repository and backend system to maintain DHCPv6 state.

classes.name: DHCPCV6_CONTEXT_LINK_OBJECT
classes.description: Context link object encapsulating DHCPv6 client, server, SentOption, or ReceivedOption data and nesting relationships.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE WanMgr_Dhcpv6Create(VOID)
methods.description: Constructs and returns a new DHCPv6 manager object, initializing function pointers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WanMgr_Dhcpv6Initialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes DHCPv6 configuration by loading current state from configuration storage and backend.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WanMgr_Dhcpv6Remove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Removes DHCPv6 configuration and data structures from memory and configuration store.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WanMgr_Dhcpv6BackendGetDhcpv6Info(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Retrieves DHCPv6 client, server, sent, and received options from backend and populates internal data structures.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WanMgr_Dhcpv6RegGetDhcpv6Info(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Reads DHCPv6 configuration from persistent storage and reconstructs internal configuration trees and objects.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WanMgr_Dhcpv6RegSetDhcpv6Info(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Saves current DHCPv6 configuration state to persistent storage for later retrieval.

methods.name: BOOL WanMgr_Dhcpv6ClientHasDelayAddedChild(PDHCPCV6_CONTEXT_LINK_OBJECT hContext)
methods.description: Checks whether a DHCPv6 client context has any pending delay-added children, indicating ongoing setup or modifications.
